acceptanceCriteria: Mutation runs are bounded by hunk count, mutant count and wall time, and every run is pinned to the tree revision and test selection digest.
A hunk claim can carry killed/survived counts with the surviving mutant described; survived mutants downgrade the claim visibly and never fail the build silently.
The prototype label is removed only after the owning spec records requirements, cost measurements and rollback to the current `prove` output.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: `prove --mutate` exists as a mutation-witness prototype and is not connected to TCQ or the change frontier. Run bounded mutation only on changed hunks, record whether the selected tests kill the mutants, and expose the result as a `discriminates` qualifier on the hunk claim. Prior art: SWE-ABS arXiv 2603.00520; Trail of Bits mewt. Owning specs: docs/specs/test-claim-qualification-v0.md, docs/specs/falsifiable-packet-v0.md.
title: tcq: wire incremental hunk mutation into a `discriminates` witness
